'''Trindello''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located within the [[Trindello system/Legends|Trindello system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It was home to the [[kargul]]. Clusters of [[Trindellan oak]] covered the moon.<ref name="G9" />
